skills.name: Cameroon and major powers: USA, Russia and China

note.text: Cameroon has developed relationships with major powers through diplomacy and changing forms of cooperation. The United States established diplomatic relations in 1960. Relations with the Soviet Union began in 1964; Cameroon recognised the Russian Federation as its successor in 1992. Diplomatic relations with the People’s Republic of China were established in 1971. Distinguish the Soviet historical period from later Russian relations. An agreement or project can express mutual aims without proving that interests coincide on every issue or that every promised benefit is delivered.

sections.heading: Your goal and connections
sections.text: By the end, you should be able to compare diplomatic histories and cooperation claims without assuming permanent alignment or guaranteed benefit. Builds on: membership, partnership and institutional source limits. Leads to: later evaluation of Cameroon’s foreign relations.

Relations with the Soviet Union began in {1964}; Cameroon recognised the Russian Federation as its successor in {1992}. Diplomatic relations with the People’s Republic of China were established in {1971}. Distinguish the Soviet historical period from later Russian relations. An agreement or project can express mutual aims without proving that interests coincide on every issue or that every promised benefit is delivered.

sections.heading: Follow the evidence and examples
sections.text: A US historical record documents recognition and embassy relations in {1960}. A Cameroonian official dossier distinguishes the Soviet and Russian stages. The {1971} China–Cameroon joint communiqué states principles and cooperation aims; these are positions expressed by its signatories, not proof of every later outcome. Compare economic and socio-political cooperation using dated evidence and the actual terms, rather than calling every loan a gift or every relationship an alliance.

sections.heading: Reason and check
sections.text: Identify actor, action, place and period before explaining a relationship. Use the practice text only for the claim it supports. Distinguish a cause, an event and an outcome; compare authentic sources before treating an interpretation as established. A sequence alone does not prove that every later outcome was inevitable.

cards.idea: Connect a specific action or event to the historical feature it illustrates.

cards.idea: Check a claim against the sequence, setting and limits of the evidence.
example: Every diplomatic relationship means automatic agreement on every policy. Correction: Diplomacy does not eliminate different interests.
The Soviet Union and Russian Federation are identical names for one unchanged historical period. Correction: Political succession and historical context must be distinguished.
A communiqué proves every future project has already succeeded. Correction: Stated principles and future outcomes differ.
Every loan is a gift and every partnership a permanent alliance. Correction: Forms of finance and political relationships differ.
